regions.text:
Have you ever made up a new game? Cooked something by mixing things in a new way?
That’s creativity! It doesn’t only belong to artists or scientists, it belongs to all of us.
Beavers build dams, birds build nests but they do it the same way every time. We, on the
other hand, can invent new music, change the way we dress, even make machines that
talk like humans! But what helps us become more creative? And what blocks us?

Story Time!

Sana lived in a small town. Her father
was a rickshaw puller, and they had
only one room with no gas connection.
She noticed that the sun heated the
tin roof of their house so much that
it could burn her fingers. One day,
she saw an old shiny plate and some
broken glass pieces, that gave her
an idea. What if she could use the
sun’s heat to cook? She tried different
setups using an old shoebox, black
paint, foil wrappers, and glass, failing
many times. But she didn’t give up.
After two weeks of testing and fixing,
Sana made a solar cooker that could
heat water and cook rice! Her teachers
were amazed. Today, her design is
being improved by an NGO to use in

villages with no access to fuel.
